items.title: Merge queue APIs now available in Bitbucket Cloud
items.summary: Merge Queues help keep your busy branches stable by testing how changes work together before they’re merged. Today, we’re introducing public APIs for Merge Queues, available to all Standard and Premium workspaces in Bitbucket Cloud. items.title: Optimize your test suite with two new agents
items.summary: Flaky tests stall pull requests. Slow tests drag out builds. Outdated tests add maintenance work that’s easy to put off. To help optimize your test suite, we’re adding two new agents in Bitbucket, Test Optimizer and Test Cleanup and an improved Flaky Test Fixer. items.title: How we used Agentic Pipelines to turn test coverage into a daily habit
items.summary: Engineers write tests for the logic that worries them and let the small details slide.
